comments.value: Please email support@vrchat.com if you continue to experience this. There were some server issues yesterday that lead to disconnects and various forms of lag.

details:
Ok so:
Sometimes, depends on my router, if i didnt restart it, i have severe issues logging in, loading into worlds, loading friends, avatars, and detail lists. Avatars will SOMETIMES load fast, sometimes it needs 10 minutes. Voicechat ingame works perfectly. Loading a world sometimes takes infinite time, sometimes it works after 10 minutes, after beeing stuck at 0 % for the entire time, jumping at the end to 100 %. I checked the Amazon Cloud Server Ping, everything is fine. I cant really pinpoint the problem. a PC Restart / Modem Restart most of the time fixes it. But it doesnt really make any sense.
